You are a TLA+ specification engineer. You will receive a natural language description of a system. Produce a complete, syntactically correct TLA+ specification that faithfully captures the described behavior. The output must be a valid TLA+ module that passes the SANY parser. Include the MODULE declaration, EXTENDS, CONSTANTS, VARIABLES, Init, Next and Spec. Include all safety invariants and liveness properties described, and any fairness conditions mentioned. Output only the TLA+ specification.

System description: This specification models a simple PlusCal algorithm with two processes, ProcA and ProcB, that both increment a shared variable x once. The translated TLA+ spec uses a program-counter variable pc to track each process's control location, initializes both processes at their single statement, and then allows either process action to execute until both reach "Done". The specification checks the standard safety-style behavior through the transition relation and includes a temporal termination property asserting that eventually all processes are done; it also permits infinite stuttering after termination via an explicit Terminating action to avoid deadlock.
